subject: Delay in payment of overdue invoices
body_text:
Dear Nexren team,

Due to a delay in collections from our own customers we will not be able to clear INV-2026-0142 and INV-2026-0157 by the due date. We expect to release the funds in the second week of September. We regret the inconvenience.

Best,
Anand Kulkarni
CFO, Meridian Automation
